newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemeni child killed in pre-election shooting.
newsitem.headline: Yemeni child killed in pre-election shooting.

text.p: A Yemeni boy was killed when gunmen opened fire on an election rally held by the ruling General Peoples' Congress (GPC), a security official said on Friday.
The official said police was searching for the assailants who fled after the shooting on Thursday in Taiz governorate, 200 km (125 miles) south of the capital Sanaa.

It was the second violent incident in the run-up to parliamentary elections on Sunday. A man was killed and several were hurt last Sunday in clashes between GPC supporters and backers of the Islah Party, the GPC's junior coalition partner in government.
A GPC official accused supporters of the Islah Party of carrying out the latest attack. An Islah Party official denied the accusation and blamed the incident on GPC supporters.
Officials of both sides have denied reports of rising tensions between the two rival parties in the election campaign.
Some 2,306 entrants, incuding 17 women, are seeking 301 seats as candidates of 12 parties or as independents in the elections -- the first parliamentary polls since a 1994 civil war.
